name: qkd_ahub_g4a-v1-COMMIT
purpose: KV-AHUB5 (LEAD3-KV, K.STA.AHUB): g3 landed hub (same RTL) re-floorplanned from the g3a per-flop clock census: compact core box under its own N pins, one fence strip per Z tree; variant A: Z inputs toward the centre, one inner strip per Z tree, z entries W/E at mid height

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_ahub_static_dw_g3_lp #(.Z_LAND(6), .AP_LAND(3), .FR_LAND(3)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/lp/qkd_ahub_static_dw_g3_lp.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub_static_dw_safe.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_core.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_pipe.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land_field_copies.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land_reset_forest.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_g4a/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_g4a/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_g4a --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_ahub_static_dw_g3_lp --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_zh_m5/views/ot_nhb_zh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_recip_ref/views/ot_qkh_recip_leaf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW kit (KV-AHUB5 10-19, after qkd_ahub_g3a / g3b gates FAIL clock_rule, ck_c 153.9-155.0 TT and Z roots 81.7-216.8 TT): same RTL as g3; the g3a per-flop census put ck_c's tail on the N-face pin flops 240 um above the core band (band 474..526 ps, pins 549..598) and each Z root's on reset pads in a second fence strip plus a trunk repaired after balancing.  (1) the core region is ONE box under its own N pins with the reciprocal leaf directly below; (2) one fence strip per Z tree (reset pads inside); (3) z clock entries midway between the strip and the macro clock pin (W/E faces); right-column Z trees mirrored so their clock pins face E.
